10k.note: 10-K describes the Allurion Gastric Balloon System (a swallowable, procedureless intragastric balloon device) and associated digital weight-loss platform; AUDACITY is the FDA pivotal IDE study supporting U.S. PMA submission. No drug pipeline.

website.note: No drug pipeline page; corporate site presents the Allurion Balloon device, AUDACITY pivotal data, and digital ecosystem (Connected Scale, Health Tracker app).

ctgov.note: Allurion device studies (e.g., AUDACITY) are categorized as device trials with phase=N/A on ClinicalTrials.gov and therefore are not captured by the P1/P2/P3 drug-phase filter; the company runs no proprietary drug clinical trials.

commercial_product.category: Medical device (intragastric balloon for weight loss) plus digital health platform
examples: Allurion Gastric Balloon System (AGBS) — swallowable, procedureless intragastric balloon (CE-marked, commercially available in 50+ countries; U.S. PMA pending based on AUDACITY pivotal IDE study)
Allurion Virtual Care Suite (Connected Scale, Health Tracker, mobile app, provider dashboard)
